steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
Put the client's name on the cover.
Tick the buildings to show on the visit.
Three files: a Word visit pack, the same pack as a printable PDF, and a PowerPoint deck.
Download the Word pack — details, key commercials, checklist and a feedback form.
Built from shows which saved analysis and version the figures came from.
Nothing is sent from here — download the files and share them yourself.
Download links expire after 10 minutes — reload the page for fresh ones.
Add evidence: attach the quote, brochure or floor plan the pack relied on.
All packs: every pack you made is listed, newest first.
Make client documents builds a proposal, workbook and decision summary from saved analyses.
Choose the requirement, then Show its analyses to pick what goes in.
